name: seis-rag-citation-coverage
description: Measure declared local retrieval citation coverage without running retrieval.

interface.shortDescription: Measure source citation fields in recorded retrieval output.
interface.longDescription: Reads bounded local JSON retrieval records and reports responses with source or citation references. It does not run RAG, score groundedness or expose document content.
interface.defaultPrompt: Measure citation coverage in recorded local retrieval outputs.
